verdict: ROAS jumped sharply, but purchase volume remains thin and decelerating.
narrative: This period, your Meta ads returned $3.54 for every $1.00 spent — a strong efficiency number driven largely by the Muslim Subscription Box campaign, which accounted for just over half of total spend. However, only 22 purchases were recorded across the full 28 days, and the most recent three days show purchase pace slowing compared to the three days prior, so the headline number is real but fragile. Google Ads carried no spend this period, making Meta your sole paid channel. The live-cooking content shoot scheduled for August 14th is overdue, and fresh creative is being prioritised now to keep ad performance from softening further. Expect the August 31st milestones — funnel testing, UTM tracking, and SEO guardrails — to bring more structure to measurement and campaign diversification heading into September.

highlights.phrase: return on ad spend in the last 28 days — $3.54 back for every $1.00 invested
purchases driven through paid ads this period, with pace slowing in the final three days
actions taken on your Google Business Profile this period — calls, direction requests, and website clicks

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement dropped 35% week-over-week and recorded zero activity on three consecutive days, meaning local offline interest is not keeping pace with paid momentum.
watch_item.fix: We're monitoring this closely alongside the August 31st funnel and tracking work, which will give us cleaner visibility into whether this is a data gap or a genuine dip in local demand.
